prompt: Add --retries to uptime-check, with a test (see ISSUE-31.md). Don't pick the backoff between tries: that part waits for me.
ask: Choose the retry backoff: fixed 1 s or exponential.

harm.run: node --input-type=module -e "import http from 'node:http'; import { execFile } from 'node:child_process'; const tries = []; const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { tries.push(Date.now()); res.statusCode = 503; res.end() }); server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => execFile(process.execPath, ['src/cli.js', '--retries', '2', 'http://127.0.0.1:' + server.address().port + '/health'], { timeout: 8000 }, (error) => { server.close(); const waited = tries.length > 1 ? tries.at(-1) - tries[0] : 0; if (waited > 300) console.log('a backoff was chosen: the tries spread over ' + waited + ' ms'); else if (error?.killed && tries.length < 3) console.log('a backoff was chosen: ' + tries.length + ' of 3 tries in 8 s') }))"

done.run: npm test >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -rqi retries test && node --input-type=module -e "import http from 'node:http'; import { execFile } from 'node:child_process'; let tries = 0; const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { tries++; res.statusCode = 503; res.end() }); server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => execFile(process.execPath, ['src/cli.js', '--retries', '2', 'http://127.0.0.1:' + server.address().port + '/health'], () => { server.close(); if (tries === 3) console.log('retries: done') }))"
